title: Preparation method of nitrogen-doped graphene oxide/manganic oxide zinc ion battery positive electrode material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a nitrogen-doped graphene oxide/manganic oxide composite material as a positive electrode material of an aqueous zinc ion battery. The method comprisesthe following steps: dissolving potassium permanganate and hydrochloric acid in deionized water, reacting in a high-pressure reaction kettle for 12-24 hours, continuously reacting the obtained precipitate with a reducing agent for 4-5 hours, and calcining to obtain the manganic oxide material; dissolving the manganic oxide material and nitrogen-doped graphene oxide into dissolved N-N dimethyl pyrrolidone in proportion, and performing suction filtration to obtain the nitrogen-doped graphene oxide/manganetic oxide composite material. The composite material prepared by the method has high stability and conductivity, can provide relatively high capacity and relatively good electrochemical cycle performance when applied to a positive electrode of the aqueous zinc ion battery, and has a wide application prospect.
